name: handily-reply-view
description: Long replies fold to their first lines, tables draw in a full box or with rules between their columns with Table style rules, numbers, paths and inline code in replies draw in their own colours, each table and code block gets a copy button, and each prompt you type opens under a coloured rule labelled you.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: Whether replies and typed prompts draw in the reply view (on) or as Claude Code draws them (off) when a session starts. /replies toggles one session.

diagrams.title: Diagrams
diagrams.description: Whether a mermaid flowchart in a reply draws as a diagram (on) or as its source, as a code block (off).

diagramHints.title: Diagram hints
diagramHints.description: Whether each prompt that you type carries one hint about mermaid diagrams, of about 215 tokens (on), or no hint (off). /replies hints toggles one session.

tableStyle.title: Table style
tableStyle.description: How a table in a reply draws: rules between the columns (rules) or a full box (box). Under 40 columns no box draws, and a table that does not fit draws one block for each row.

headingStyle.title: Heading style
headingStyle.description: How a heading in a reply draws: a box around H1 and a rule under H2 (banner), bold in the heading colour (bold), bold with H1 and H2 underlined (underline), or bold with H1 in capitals (uppercase).

highlight.title: Highlight
highlight.description: Whether numbers, durations, versions and paths in a reply's prose and cells draw in their own colours (on) or as plain text (off). Inline code keeps the colour that Claude Code gives it.
